title: Heavenly Fusion
summary: Mu Chen pays 4,000 spirit value a day to cultivate in the Level 6 Spirit Collecting Formation and dives to the bottom of its lake, where Jiuyou helps him merge the Jiuyou Flames into his spiritual power through their bloodline and compress them into a spark. Su Ling'er tracks him down; he first concedes, then fights her whip to a standstill that ends with the two of them tied together, and she leaves humiliated. On Jiuyou's advice he stops forcing his divine soul and breaks through to the Heavenly Fusion Stage. A spiritual tide is coming that will fruit the Heavenly Spiritual Lotus, whose seeds stabilise new power, so he joins the hunt. There he runs into Su Ling'er again, her rival Xu Qingqing, and Huo Feng, boss of the Qinghong Club, who demands that Mu Chen return Mo Lun's spirit value; Mu Chen refuses.
events: Mu Chen enters the Level 6 Spirit Collecting Formation
Jiuyou merges the Jiuyou Flames into his spiritual power at the lake bottom
Su Ling'er challenges him; the fight ends with them tangled in her whip
Mu Chen breaks through to Heavenly Fusion
He heads for the Heavenly Spiritual Lotus to stabilise the new realm
Xu Qingqing and Huo Feng appear; Huo Feng demands Mo Lun's spirit value back
cultivation: Mu Chen breaks through from Spirit to Heavenly Fusion, Initial Phase, after merging the Jiuyou Flames. Mu Chen judges Su Ling'er 'about to reach the late stage' of Heavenly Fusion, i.e. Heavenly Fusion, Middle Phase.
